note: Offered at the stair lever. Two are drawn per descent from the run seed and the floor index, so the same seed always offers the same choice. The pact replaces the run's modifiers for the floor below.

pacts.label: Quiet Halls
pacts.description: Fewer things awake below. The floor keeps its treasure.

pacts.label: Cursed Depths
pacts.description: Wardens walk the floor below, and they are worth opening.

pacts.label: The Starved Road
pacts.description: No hearth will take below. What you carry, you carry.
pacts.gain: The floor boss keeps a hoard.

pacts.label: Barred Descent
pacts.description: The doors below have been kept shut a long time.
pacts.gain: More sealed vaults, more in them.
pacts.cost: More locks between you and the stair.

pacts.label: The Unlit Way
pacts.description: You will not be given a map of what is below.
pacts.cost: The floor stays dark on the map.

pacts.label: Hunted
pacts.description: Whatever is below has already started moving toward you.
pacts.gain: Richer vaults, and the hearths stay lit.
pacts.cost: They are faster and they do not stop.

pacts.label: Iron Penance
pacts.description: Everything below is armoured, and slow, and patient.
pacts.gain: They are slower. The boss keeps a hoard.
